sources.support: Teaching table maps5pm to saa kumi na moja jioni and8am to saa mbili asubuhi.
English and Swahili clock systems coexist; schedules and appointments require identifying the convention.

adjudication: A bare saa5jioni or saa8asubuhi is not automatically accepted as equivalent to5pm or8am. Convention ambiguity is unresolved and may be material; preserve literal anchors or establish convention explicitly. This affects full-reference acceptance and must be checked even if numeric digits are unchanged.
